title: Modeled bill after staged VM retirement
method: Synthetic inventory:20 VMs×(100 compute+20 storage)=2,400/month. Stopping eight saves 8×100=800, leaving 1,600. Removing their storage saves 8×20=160 more, leaving 1,440. Assumes usage-based billing and excludes snapshots, addresses and commitment effects.
alt: Modeled bill after staged VM retirement. Initial inventory: 2400 currency units per month; Eight VMs stopped: 1600 currency units per month; Eight fully retired: 1440 currency units per month. Illustrative values.
